issues: 25 块瓦片各自配一块随机灰蓝渐变，拼齐后像一张拼布，看不出是“一整面海报”
中央的 REASSEMBLE 是把卡名打在画面上的调试占位，没设字体，回退成 Times 衬线
字悬浮在瓦片之上、在飞散前单独淡出，和碎片的物理事件脱节
瓦片是平涂色块，翻转时没有明暗变化；背景是死平的 #0b0b10
inOutCubic 落位是软着陆，没有入槽感；飞行段没有运动模糊，hold 段完全静止
changes: 25 块改为切同一张海报（按格位偏移 background-position）：冷色深场、左上柔光、底部发光地平线弧，拼齐才看见完整画面；拼缝 2px
标题换成出版级的眉题 INTRODUCING 加主标题 Every piece, in place.（系统字体，700 字重，-0.035em），印在海报切片上，t=0.42–0.52 亮起，退场时被碎片一起撕走
瓦片按朝向做明暗（cos rx · cos ry，最暗压 0.6），顶沿 1px 受光高光；落位曲线改为 bezier(0.42,0,0.3,1)，落位后 ~10f 内有一次 ≤2.5° 的阻尼小摆
聚合段和飞散段包 CameraMotionBlur（170°/8 采样），hold 段不包、保持锐利；hold 段整面海报极缓推近 3%
背景改成带色相的柔光深场加暗角，海报身后的环境光随拼合程度亮起；颗粒放在模糊层之外；DesignStage 用 raster=zoom，3D 瓦片里的字不糊
issuesEn: Each of the 25 tiles had its own random gray-blue gradient, so the assembled grid read as a patchwork rather than one poster
The central REASSEMBLE was a debug placeholder (the card name) with no font set, falling back to Times serif
The text floated above the tiles and faded out on its own before the scatter, disconnected from the physical event
Tiles were flat color with no shading as they turned, over a dead-flat #0b0b10 background
The inOutCubic landing was a soft touchdown with no sense of seating; no motion blur on the flight segments and a fully static hold
changesEn: All 25 tiles now slice one shared poster (background-position offset per cell): cool deep field, top-left soft light and a glowing horizon arc at the bottom, so the full image appears only once assembled; 2px seams

The title is now a publication-grade eyebrow INTRODUCING plus headline Every piece, in place. (system font, 700 weight, -0.035em), printed on the poster slices; it lights up at t=0.42–0.52 and is torn away with the fragments on exit
Tiles shade by orientation (cos rx · cos ry, up to 0.6 darkening) with a 1px lit top edge; the landing curve is now bezier(0.42,0,0.3,1), followed by one damped wobble of ≤2.5° within ~10f
The assemble and scatter segments are wrapped in CameraMotionBlur (170 degrees, 8 samples) while the hold stays sharp; the poster pushes in a slow 3% during the hold

The background is now a hued soft-light dark field with vignette, plus an ambient glow behind the poster that brightens as it assembles; grain sits outside the blur; DesignStage uses raster=zoom so text inside the 3D tiles stays crisp
